globalisation.en: Globalisation has brought cheaper goods but has also destroyed some local jobs.
globalisation.zh: 全球化带来了更便宜的商品,但也使一些本地工作消失。

global-village.en: The internet has turned the world into a global village.
global-village.zh: 互联网把世界变成了一个地球村。

international.en: International cooperation is essential to solve the problem of climate change.
international.zh: 要解决气候变化问题,国际合作至关重要。

cross-cultural.en: Cross-cultural experiences can help young people to become more tolerant.
cross-cultural.zh: 跨文化经历能帮助年轻人变得更加宽容。

multicultural.en: Living in a multicultural society teaches people to respect different customs.
multicultural.zh: 生活在多元文化社会中,人们学会尊重不同的习俗。

diversity.en: Cultural diversity makes a society richer and more interesting.
diversity.zh: 文化多样性让社会更丰富、更有趣。

cultural-identity.en: Language is a central part of a nation's cultural identity.
cultural-identity.zh: 语言是一个民族文化认同的核心部分。

tradition.en: Every society should try to keep its best traditions alive.
tradition.zh: 每个社会都应该努力让最好的传统延续下去。

traditional.en: Traditional skills may disappear unless young people are willing to learn them.
traditional.zh: 除非年轻人愿意学习,否则传统技艺可能消失。

custom.en: Visitors should learn about local customs before travelling to another country.
custom.zh: 游客去其他国家之前应了解当地习俗。

convention.en: Social conventions about marriage have changed greatly in the last fifty years.
convention.zh: 过去五十年,有关婚姻的社会惯例发生了很大变化。

convention.en: Teachers from around the world will attend the annual convention in Paris.
convention.zh: 来自世界各地的教师将参加在巴黎举行的年度大会。

value.en: Parents should teach their children the value of hard work.
value.zh: 父母应该教导孩子勤奋的价值。

value.en: Modern societies tend to value wealth more than wisdom.
value.zh: 现代社会往往重视财富胜过智慧。

norm.en: Living alone has become the norm for older people in many countries.
norm.zh: 在许多国家,老年人独居已成为一种规范。

etiquette.en: Business people should learn the etiquette of the country they are visiting.
etiquette.zh: 商务人士应该学习所访问国家的礼仪。

assimilation.en: The assimilation of immigrants into a new society can take several generations.
assimilation.zh: 移民融入新社会可能需要几代人的时间。

integration.en: Language classes can help with the integration of new immigrants.
integration.zh: 语言课程有助于新移民融入社会。

homogenisation.en: Some people fear the homogenisation of culture around the world.
homogenisation.zh: 有些人担心全球文化趋于同质化。

westernisation.en: The westernisation of diets has led to more cases of obesity in Asia.
westernisation.zh: 饮食西化导致亚洲的肥胖病例增多。

cultural-exchange.en: Cultural exchange programmes allow students to experience life in another country.
cultural-exchange.zh: 文化交流项目让学生能体验另一个国家的生活。

mutual-understanding.en: International student exchanges can promote mutual understanding between young people.
mutual-understanding.zh: 国际学生交流可以促进年轻人之间的相互理解。

stereotype.en: Television often reinforces the stereotype of older people as weak and helpless.
stereotype.zh: 电视常常强化老年人虚弱无助的刻板印象。

prejudice.en: Education is one of the best ways to fight prejudice against other groups.
prejudice.zh: 教育是消除对其他群体偏见的最好方法之一。

discrimination.en: Laws against discrimination have improved opportunities for women at work.
discrimination.zh: 反歧视法律改善了女性的工作机会。

racism.en: Schools have an important role to play in the fight against racism.
racism.zh: 学校在反对种族主义的斗争中发挥着重要作用。

tolerance.en: Travel can encourage tolerance of people from different backgrounds.
tolerance.zh: 旅行可以促进对不同背景的人的宽容。

ethnic.en: People from different ethnic backgrounds should have equal rights at work.
ethnic.zh: 不同民族背景的人在工作中应享有平等权利。

minority-group.en: Every minority group should have the right to use its own language.
minority-group.zh: 每个少数群体都应有权使用自己的语言。

immigrant.en: Each immigrant brings new skills and ideas to the receiving country.
immigrant.zh: 每位移民都为接收国带来新的技能和想法。

emigrate.en: Many skilled workers emigrate to wealthier countries in search of higher pay.
emigrate.zh: 许多技术工人移居到较富裕的国家,寻求更高的薪水。

migrant-worker.en: A migrant worker may send most of their income back home.
migrant-worker.zh: 外来务工人员可能把大部分收入寄回家。

free-trade.en: Supporters of free trade argue that it creates wealth for all countries.
free-trade.zh: 自由贸易的支持者认为它为所有国家创造财富。

interdependence.en: Modern trade has led to greater interdependence between nations.
interdependence.zh: 现代贸易使国家之间更加相互依赖。

folk.en: Young people should be encouraged to learn the folk songs of their region.
folk.zh: 应该鼓励年轻人学习本地区的民间歌曲。

folk-festival.en: The annual folk festival brings local musicians and visitors together.
folk-festival.zh: 一年一度的民间节日把当地音乐人和游客聚集在一起。

handicraft.en: Tourism can support local people who make and sell traditional handicrafts.
handicraft.zh: 旅游业能帮助制作和销售传统手工艺品的当地人。

craftsmanship.en: Machine-made goods rarely show the same craftsmanship as those made by hand.
craftsmanship.zh: 机器制造的商品很少能展现手工制品的手艺。

artisan.en: A local artisan can spend many weeks making a single wooden chair.
artisan.zh: 当地的工匠可能花几周时间制作一把木椅。

art-gallery.en: Entry to the national art gallery should be free for all children.
art-gallery.zh: 所有儿童都应免费进入国家美术馆。

exhibit.en: Visitors enjoy museums more when they are allowed to touch an exhibit.
exhibit.zh: 如果可以触摸展品,参观者会更喜欢博物馆。

exhibit.en: The national museum will exhibit these works of art for the first time.
exhibit.zh: 国家博物馆将首次展出这些艺术品。

masterpiece.en: Every child should have the chance to see a great masterpiece in person.
masterpiece.zh: 每个孩子都应该有机会亲眼看到伟大的杰作。

sculpture.en: Public art, such as a sculpture in a park, can improve a city's image.
sculpture.zh: 公园里的雕塑等公共艺术能提升城市形象。

literature.en: Studying literature helps young people to understand different points of view.
literature.zh: 学习文学有助于年轻人理解不同的观点。

fiction.en: Reading fiction may help children to understand the feelings of others.
fiction.zh: 读小说可能有助于孩子理解他人的感受。

poetry.en: Children today read far less poetry than previous generations did.
poetry.zh: 如今的孩子读的诗歌比前几代人少得多。

drama.en: Drama classes can give shy children greater confidence in speaking.
drama.zh: 戏剧课能让害羞的孩子说话更有自信。

cultural-heritage.en: Governments should spend money on protecting the nation's cultural heritage.
cultural-heritage.zh: 政府应该投入资金保护国家的文化遗产。

intangible.en: Intangible benefits of the arts are often difficult to measure in money.
intangible.zh: 艺术无形的益处往往很难用金钱衡量。

emigrant.en: An emigrant may find it hard to leave family and friends behind.
emigrant.zh: 移民可能很难离开家人和朋友。

immigrate.en: Thousands of young professionals immigrate to the country each year.
immigrate.zh: 每年有数千名年轻专业人士移入这个国家。

aesthetic.en: New buildings should be judged on aesthetic grounds as well as on cost.
aesthetic.zh: 评价新建筑既要看成本,也要看审美。

artistic.en: Schools should encourage artistic ability as much as academic success.
artistic.zh: 学校应该像鼓励学业成功一样鼓励艺术才能。

inspiration.en: Nature has long been a source of inspiration for artists and writers.
inspiration.zh: 大自然一直是艺术家和作家的灵感来源。

portrait.en: A portrait of the queen hangs in the main hall of the museum.
portrait.zh: 博物馆大厅里挂着一幅女王的肖像。

portray.en: Television programmes often portray older people in a negative way.
portray.zh: 电视节目常常以负面的方式描绘老年人。

impressionism.en: Impressionism changed the way that painters thought about light and colour.
impressionism.zh: 印象派改变了画家对光和色彩的看法。

watercolour.en: Each watercolour in the exhibition shows a different view of the river.
watercolour.zh: 展览中的每幅水彩画都展现了河流的不同景色。

canvas.en: The artist painted the huge canvas for a public building in the capital.
canvas.zh: 这位艺术家为首都的一座公共建筑绘制了这幅巨大的画布作品。

palette.en: The painter used a limited palette of blues and greys.
palette.zh: 这位画家使用了以蓝色和灰色为主的有限调色板。

pigment.en: Early painters made pigment from coloured rocks and plants.
pigment.zh: 早期的画家用彩色岩石和植物制作颜料。

embroidery.en: Traditional embroidery from the region is now sold around the world.
embroidery.zh: 该地区的传统刺绣现在销往世界各地。

tragedy.en: Shakespeare's greatest tragedy is still performed in many languages.
tragedy.zh: 莎士比亚最伟大的悲剧至今仍以多种语言上演。

opera.en: Tickets for the opera are too expensive for many ordinary people.
opera.zh: 歌剧票对许多普通人来说太贵了。

ballet.en: The government should support ballet and other art forms that struggle financially.
ballet.zh: 政府应该支持芭蕾舞和其他经济困难的艺术形式。

orchestra.en: The city's orchestra offers free concerts for local school children.
orchestra.zh: 这座城市的管弦乐队为当地学童提供免费音乐会。

symphony.en: The composer wrote his final symphony when he was almost completely deaf.
symphony.zh: 这位作曲家创作最后一部交响乐时几乎完全失聪。

chorus.en: The school chorus gave a performance at the local home for older people.
chorus.zh: 学校合唱团在当地养老院演出。

percussion.en: Children enjoy playing percussion in school music lessons.
percussion.zh: 孩子们喜欢在学校音乐课上演奏打击乐器。

cello.en: My daughter began learning the cello at the age of six.
cello.zh: 我女儿六岁开始学大提琴。

conservatory.en: She won a place to study piano at the national conservatory.
conservatory.zh: 她考入国家音乐学院学习钢琴。

cultural-diversity.en: Immigration has increased the cultural diversity of many large cities.
cultural-diversity.zh: 移民增加了许多大城市的文化多样性。

unity.en: National sporting events can create a strong sense of unity.
unity.zh: 全国性体育赛事能营造强烈的团结感。

motif.en: A common motif in local art is the bird, which represents freedom.
motif.zh: 当地艺术中常见的图案是鸟,它象征自由。

weave.en: Older women in the village still weave cloth using traditional methods.
weave.zh: 村里年长的妇女仍用传统方法织布。

realism.en: The film was praised for its realism in showing the life of ordinary people.
realism.zh: 这部电影以现实主义手法展现普通人的生活,因此受到赞扬。

artwork.en: Public artwork can make a city centre more attractive to visitors.
artwork.zh: 公共艺术品能让市中心对游客更有吸引力。

repertoire.en: The theatre's repertoire includes both classic plays and modern works.
repertoire.zh: 这家剧院的全部节目既有经典戏剧,也有现代作品。

commemorate.en: A national holiday was created to commemorate the end of the war.
commemorate.zh: 设立了一个全国性节日来纪念战争结束。

funeral.en: Funeral customs vary greatly from one culture to another.
funeral.zh: 葬礼习俗因文化不同而差异很大。

tourism.en: Tourism creates many jobs but can also damage historic sites.
tourism.zh: 旅游业创造了许多就业机会,但也可能破坏历史遗迹。

tourist-attraction.en: The old castle has become the region's most popular tourist attraction.
tourist-attraction.zh: 这座古堡已成为该地区最受欢迎的旅游景点。

mass-tourism.en: Mass tourism can destroy the natural beauty that attracts visitors in the first place.
mass-tourism.zh: 大众旅游可能破坏最初吸引游客的自然美景。

ecotourism.en: Ecotourism can provide income for local people while protecting wildlife.
ecotourism.zh: 生态旅游能为当地人提供收入,同时保护野生动物。

hospitality-industry.en: The hospitality industry provides millions of jobs for young people.
hospitality-industry.zh: 酒店业为年轻人提供了数百万个就业机会。

foreign-exchange.en: Tourism is a major source of foreign exchange for many developing countries.
foreign-exchange.zh: 旅游业是许多发展中国家外汇的主要来源。

local-economy.en: Spending by visitors can give a valuable boost to the local economy.
local-economy.zh: 游客的消费能大大推动当地经济。

job-opportunity.en: Each new hotel creates a job opportunity for people living nearby.
job-opportunity.zh: 每家新酒店都为附近居民创造就业机会。

overcrowding.en: Overcrowding at historic sites spoils the experience for many visitors.
overcrowding.zh: 历史遗迹的过度拥挤破坏了许多游客的体验。

commercialisation.en: The commercialisation of traditional festivals has reduced their cultural meaning.
commercialisation.zh: 传统节日的商业化削弱了它们的文化意义。

authentic.en: Tourists often want an authentic experience of local life.
authentic.zh: 游客往往希望真正体验当地生活。

authenticity.en: Performances for tourists can lose their cultural authenticity over time.
authenticity.zh: 为游客举办的表演可能随着时间推移而失去文化真实性。

exotic.en: Cheap flights have made exotic destinations available to ordinary people.
exotic.zh: 廉价航班让普通人也能前往异域目的地。

broaden-ones-horizons.en: Travelling abroad is an excellent way to broaden one's horizons.
broaden-ones-horizons.zh: 出国旅行是开阔眼界的极好方式。

hospitable.en: People in the region are hospitable and often invite visitors into their homes.
hospitable.zh: 该地区的人们很好客,经常邀请游客到家里做客。

local-residents.en: Tourism should bring real benefits to local residents as well as to companies.
local-residents.zh: 旅游业应该给当地居民以及公司都带来实际好处。

wear-and-tear.en: Millions of visitors cause wear and tear on these ancient buildings.
wear-and-tear.zh: 数百万游客造成这些古建筑的损耗。

carrying-capacity.en: The island has already exceeded its carrying capacity for tourists.
carrying-capacity.zh: 这座岛的游客数量已经超过了它的承载能力。

hospitality.en: Visitors are often surprised by the warm hospitality of local people.
hospitality.zh: 游客常常对当地人的热情好客感到惊讶。
